note: Campground on Rolling Hills Reservoir about 20 km south of Brooks, owned and operated by the Eastern Irrigation District. Treed sites with gravel pads and a grassy area; 35 sites are seasonal leases awarded by an April draw. Two sandy beaches with sheltered swimming, a dog beach, playgrounds, and a marina with boat launch; trailered boats must check in at the office under the district's invasive-species program. Main gate locked at 11 pm (one-way exit gate). --Claude
summary: Confirmed: EID-run reservoir campground, C$45 incl. GST (+C$5 for 50 A), FCFS with same-day phone hold, 14-night max; 2026 season May 14 - Sep 10 (stored May 1 - Oct 31 was note-derived). Fees, hookups (electric 30->50), sites, facilities, season, booking written; note rewritten. Lakefront supported on imagery.
flags: OWNERSHIP (stored private): the page says both 'owned and operated by the Eastern Irrigation District' and 'The campground is privately owned and operated by the Eastern Irrigation District'. An Alberta irrigation district is a corporation under the Irrigation Districts Act governed by a board elected by its water users - not a municipality and not a provincial agency. Recommend keeping private (the operator's own word); reviewer's call if irrigation districts should count as local.
PRICE: C$45 including GST (50 A C$50). Under C$69 - passes; gateways.py: none within 40 km.
